name: How do I know if I need a new tank water heater?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if I need a new tank water heater?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs that indicate you might need a new tank water heater include a lack of hot water, rust-colored water, strange noises like rumbling or popping from the tank, or visible leaks. The typical lifespan of a tank water heater is 8-12 years. If your unit is older than this and exhibiting these symptoms, it's often more cost-effective to replace it than to repair it, especially when considering potential efficiency gains from newer models. Our technicians can assess the condition of your current unit.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for lack of hot water, rust, strange noises, or leaks. Tank water heaters typically last 8-12 years.
